en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 3.Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd narrated from Yaḥyā al-Ḥalabī, from Ibn Muskān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥīm al-Qaṣīr who said, “I said to Abā Jaʿfar (a), ‘Ṣāliḥ ibn Mītham narrated to me from ʿAbāyah al-Asadī that he heard ʿAlī (a) saying, “By Allah, no servant [of Allah] ever hates me and dies with hatred for me but that he sees me at the moment of his death in a way that he hates, and no servant ever loves me and dies with love for me but that he sees me at the time of his death in a way that he loves.”’ So Abū Jaʿfar (a) said, ‘Yes, and the Messenger of Allah (ṣ) will be on his right side.’”
